gridDNA: A central, slightly angled product display (shopping basket filled with product boxes) occupies the mid-to-lower canvas, framed by a large, prominent speech bubble offer at the top-left and a smaller, angled badge at the bottom-right. A minimal background provides contrast.

zones.position: top-left, starting 6% from top, 5% from left, contained within a speech bubble shape
zones.treatment: white bold text, '2 FREE!' in yellow bold, inside a solid blue speech bubble container with a white outline, 'FREE' in all caps
zones.note: Main value proposition, visually dominant due to size and colour contrast.

zones.position: mid-canvas, clustered within the basket, angled
zones.treatment: standard product packaging, multiple units visible
zones.note: Multiple units displayed to reinforce the bundle offer.
Provides a clean, neutral backdrop for product and graphic elements.

zones.position: mid-to-lower canvas, angled, starting 35% from top, extending to bottom
zones.note: Visual container for products, reinforces 'shopping' or 'bundle' concept.

zones.position: bottom-right, angled, overlapping the basket, starting 70% from top, 55% from left
zones.treatment: white bold text on a solid red oval/pill shape with a slight white outline, all caps
zones.note: Reinforces product popularity and bundle value.

zones.position: bottom-most, full width, starting 90% from top, 5% from left
zones.treatment: small, dark grey text, regular weight

typeScale: headline (offer) ~12-15% of canvas height, badge text ~5-6%, caption ~1%
colourBlocking: Top-left quadrant dominated by a bright blue speech bubble. Bottom-right features a bright red badge. The central area is occupied by the blue basket and product boxes, all against a neutral beige background.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the top-right and bottom-left corners, and around the central product arrangement, allowing key elements (offer, product, badge) to stand out without clutter.
eyePath: Offer (speech bubble) -> Product (basket with boxes) -> Badge (BEST SELLER BUNDLE) -> Caption (disclaimer)
whyItWins: The layout immediately communicates a clear, high-value offer and visually presents the product bundle, creating an instant perception of quantity and savings through prominent graphic elements.
